wallpaper <wallpaper> objects [<filter>]

Lists the wallpaper's parts as a tree: each part's id, type and name,
and whether its author or you hid it. It reads the wallpaper's files, so
it works for any wallpaper. A filter word narrows it: a type such as
particle, or part of a name such as rain. The depth comes from a walk
that shows a part whose parent is missing, or that repeats in a parent
cycle, as a root, while -j's parent still names the parent the scene
gives.
